column3:
Tell: Avg world temp increase 1C per 2yrs. In 30 yrs: Jan avg low will be +10, Jul avg high +44. 
My ranking: Stressor for me; Hazard for my children.  Weight: 5. Reason: my skin doesn't accept suntan anymore

Tell: Avg annual deforestation rate is 0.3%. In 30 yrs: 9% less forest. Means 9% less oxygen. 
My ranking: Stressor for me; Hazard for my children
Weight: 3. Reason: air dynamics should allow us to survive despite this

Tell: Agriculture uses 72% of global freshwater. Global Agriculture CAGR: 4%. In 6  yrs we must compete for water with agriculture.
My ranking: Hazard.
Weight: 3. Reason: I think it's possible to invent more water efficient methods during the nearest future

Tell: Doomsday Clock in 1984 (iciest point during the Cold War) 3 min, 2026 - 85 sec (the closest time ever). 
My ranking: Hazard
Weight: 10. Reason: I live in Ukraine and Russia threatens Ukraine with nuclear weapons more times than Soviet Union threatens USA during all its history

Tell: 65 (all-time peak) during the last decade, including 13 high-intensity great loss wars, compared to 30-40 during the previous decade, with 4 to 6 high-intensity ones. In 30 years it can grow up to 257 conflicts with 68 high-intensity ones. We have 197 countries right now. It means 70% of countries will be involved in high-intensity wars
My ranking: Hazard
Weight: 10. Reason: Russia has already demonstrated that it's going to keep its genocide tactics against Ukrainian civilians

Tell: during last decade it dropped from 45k annual death toll to 24k
My ranking: Stressor for me. Amplifier for my children
Weight: 8. Reason: Russia's tactics can transform into terrorism, which most of its population is leaning toward, it requires a lot of time even if the Russian regime would be flipped in the nearest future.

Tell: that rapid acceleration could leave humanity unable to follow or intervene in future AI decisions. No prior data. CAGR 800%.
My ranking: Stressor 
Weight: 2. Reason: before AI decision transforms into a physical action is a long journey

Tell: AI misuse has transitioned from a niche, theoretical risk into an active, everyday threat spanning cyber warfare, mass disinformation, and algorithmic targeting on actual battlefields. Annual incidents avg: 80 . CAGR: 800 %. In 30 yrs 10^28 incidents
My ranking: Hazard
My ranking: 8. Reason: It depends on who owns the technology. If an authoritarian state like Russia, North Korea, Iran, or China. They will probably just overlook the security of mistake.

Tell: 420 million cyberattacks a year, meaning 13 attacks every second. 50% of the attacks are on critical infrastructure. CAGR: 18% with 400% growth spike in critical infrastructure, especially the aviation and transport sectors. In two years, all public transport will be under threat.
My ranking: Stressor
Weight: 7. Reason: despite Russian-associated hackers attacking critical infrastructure almost every year, the maximum damage I can recall is a two-day pause in bank operations.

Tell: Irkutsk laboratory incident (2026). No prior data. 
My ranking: Amplifier
Weight: 1. Reason: as this kind of study is highly regulated and we have no evidence, neither for baseline nor for consequences, I see no substantial risk

Tell: influenza and zootonic pandemics (covid-19, ebola, hiv). Annual avg death toll 1.5 mln this decade vs 800 ths previos decade. CAGR 90%. In 30yrs it will be 10 mln annually.
MY ranking: Amplifier for me. Stresser for my children
Weight: 4. Reason: I live in a moderately populated area. Less risk of contact, more chances to secure myself.

Tell: The non-performing loans (NPL)ratio decreased during the last decade from 1-7.5% to 0.7-1.5%. In 30 yrs it can be 0.25-0.3%
My ranking: Amplifier
Weight: 4. Reason: during the whole, I personally lost a quite substantial amount of money. I could live a different life. However, the Soviet Union's breakup brought a wave of banditry on the streets. I consider it a secondary risk of the financial collapse

Tell: mostly by books, tv series, and institutional publications. No prior data
My ranking: Amplifier
Weight: 6. Reason: powerful unknown for the most people. However knowing by myself what Chernobyl means not by HBO series, but literally. I'd never underestimate it.
